# iCE40 UP5K boards

Lattice iCE40 UltraPlus UP5K: 5.3k LUTs, 128 KB SPRAM, DSP, RGB driver; open flow yosys + nextpnr-ice40 + icepack. Cores use SB_* primitives.

| Board | FPGA | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [iCEBreaker](icebreaker.md) | iCE40 UP5K, SG48 | The reference open-source UP5K board, with PMOD ports and many workshop examples. |
| [UPduino](upduino.md) | iCE40 UP5K, SG48 | Low-cost UP5K board in DIP format. |
| [iCESugar](icesugar.md) | iCE40 UP5K, SG48 | Small UP5K board with a drag-and-drop programmer. |
| [Fomu](fomu.md) | iCE40 UP5K, UWG30 | UP5K board that fits inside a USB port; foboot DFU bootloader. |
| [pico-ice](pico-ice.md) | iCE40 UP5K, SG48 | RP2040 microcontroller plus UP5K; the RP2040 programs the FPGA (DFU on the MCU). |
{% endraw %}
